notes.title: Mahasona 0.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
In this update, We have fixed some of the major bugs in the game. And we add some new things and balance the gameplay. 

What's New


 Added a recovery time when Mahasona gets knocked. 
Designer Note:-
("When Mahasona gets knocked he will be spawned back at his throne and was able to get back into hunting kids fast. This lead to Mahasona Winning the game for the most time since he will respawn with full health. We want to give some time for Kids to recover so we added a Respawn Timer. So When Mahasona gets knocked he will be placed in a Recovery Time Until the timer end Mahasona can't move or attack.")



Bugs Fixes


All the boxes in the world are now breakable. 
Fix an issue with Mini Demon knocked UI.
Fix an issue with Box highlight.
Fix an issue with "Tharindu's" Health bar.
Balanced some character's damage radius.


-RAM Studios

notes.title: Mahasona 0.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
In this update, we have addressed some issues and also add some quality of life changes to the game. 


Quality of Life Changes


 Players can now see who knocked Mahasona on the HUD.
 Added an In-game voice chat activities indicate on the HUD.
 Players can now change the volume level of Ingame voice chat.
 Character Damage has been balanced.


Updated Sound

 When Crouched players will no longer make footstep sounds.
 Added new sounds effects for in-game activities.



Bugs Fixes


Fix an issue where players won't able to change the Master Volume level.
General bug fixes and improvements.


-RAM Studios

notes.title: Mahasona 0.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
In this update, we have addressed some issues and also add some quality of life changes to the game. 


Quality of Life Changes


 Your Ping (The network latency between a player's client and the game server) Now show on the HUD.
 HUD now shows more information about actions that players are performing in the game for example:-Who placed an item in the treasure point, Who got captured by Mahasona, etc.
 You can now see what characters players are playing as on the HUD.


Updated Sound


 Added new voice lines for Mahasona give him more of a personality.
Added some new audio cues for some actions.
Improved overall sounds in the game.


Bugs Fixes


 Fix an issue where players were able to crouch walks at the same speed as walking.
Fix an issue with stairs collision that causes players to get stuck on stairs.
General bug fixes and improvements.


-RAM Studios

notes.title: Mahasona Beta is now Available!
notes.content:
Mahasona Beta is now Available!

Mahasona is a Third-person, Multiplayer Social horror game. Where you can team up with other players as a team of four kids to find a treasure that belongs to a Demon name Mahasona. As Mahasona you have to stop the kids from finding the Treasure before sunrise.

Why Beta

We are actively working on improving the game. We want our players to know the current state of the game. We want your feedback in order to improve the game and add new content. 

Game Current State

Mahasona is playable and all the systems we planned for the game are implemented and working. But some minor issues can be expected. We also have more stuff coming.

What Coming Next

We have new content coming in the further down the line to enhance player experiences. We are actively gathering feedback to improve the game and see what works and what doesn't. So feel free to give us your feedback.

Important Noticed 
A few days ago we accidentally released an early development build of the game and manage to remove it. But some players manage to download and play the game. We are highly recommended that you redownload the game to make sure that you are getting the right game build Or you can verify your game via steam to see any new updates, Available.


Thank you and we hope you all enjoy the game.
